__broaden__.μένεος: μένος — might, fury, passion; neut. gen. sg., genitive of material or cause: ’with fury’ · also neut. gen. sg., genitive of separation after ἀπογυιώσῃς: ’(unnerve) of might’ · also neut. gen. sg., object of λάθωμαι: ’(forget) fury’
__broaden__.μαχώμεθα: μάχομαι — fight; pres. subj. 1 pl., contracted (epic μαχεώμεθα): ’that we may fight’ · also pres. subj. 1 pl., hortatory: ’let us fight’

__broaden__.γενέσθαι: γίγνομαι — become, come to be; aor. inf. mid.: ’to come about, be made’ · also with περί + gen.: ’to be superior to’ · also aor. inf. mid. after φημί, predicate: ’to be, to have become’ · also aor. inf. mid. after δότε, acc. subject and predicate: ’that he become’ (δότε … γενέσθαι ’grant that he become’) · also aor. inf. mid. after ἔλπομαι: ’to have been born’ (ἐν Σαλαμῖνι γενέσθαι ’to have been born on Salamis’) · also aor. inf. mid. after ὤφελλε, in a wish: ’to have come to be’ (ἣ μὴ ὤφελλε γενέσθαι) · also aor. inf. mid. with a perfect participle (πεφυγμένον … γενέσθαι): ’to have escaped’

__broaden__.ἔλασσον: ἐλάσσων — less, smaller (comp. of ἐλαχύς); neut. acc. sg. used as adv., epic (= Attic ἔλαττον): ’less’ · also ἐλαύνω — drive, thrust; aor. imper. 2 sg. act., epic -σσ- (= Attic ἔλασον): ’drive (it)!’

__broaden__.σεῖο: σύ — you (sg.); gen. sg., epic σεῖο (= Attic σοῦ), after περί: ’about you’ · also gen. of comparison after a comparative: ’than you’ (σεῖο … ὀλοώτερος ’deadlier than you’) · also gen. governed by εἵνεκα: ’on your account’ (εἵνεκα σεῖο) · also gen. sg. after ἀπό: ’away from you’ · also gen. object of μεθήσω: ’let go of you’ (σεῖο μεθήσω ’I will not give you up’) · also gen. sg. of source after ἐξ: ’from you’ · also gen. object of χατίζω: ’need of you’ · also gen. sg. after ἀντία: ’against you’ · also gen. sg. in a genitive absolute with καταφθιμένοιο: ’you having perished’
__broaden__.κεν: κε(ν) — epic particle (= Attic ἄν); with the opt., potential: ’might, would’; with the subj. in conditions after εἰ, αἰ · also + subj. or fut. indic. in a main or relative clause: ’shall’ (’I shall take’; ’to whom I come’) · also + subj. in a general relative clause: ’whatever’ (ὅττί κεν εἴπῃς) · also with a past indic., contrary to fact: ’would have’ (ἔνθά κεν … ἐτύχθη) · also with an impf. indic., past potential: ’would be’ (κεν … κέρδιον ἦεν ’it would be better’) · also + subj. in a temporal clause after εἰς ὅ: ’until’ (εἰς ὅ κεν … μάχωνται ’until they fight’) · also εἴ κεν + opt., in a condition: ’if … should’ · also + subj. in a purpose clause after ὥς: ’so that … may’ · also + subj. in a temporal clause after ὅτε: ’whenever’ (ὅτε κεν … ἵκωμαι ’whenever I come’) · also ἤ κεν + subj., in an indirect alternative question: ’whether … or’ · also ὅππως κεν + subj., in an indirect question: ’how … may’ · also ὄφρά κεν + subj., purpose: ’so that … may’ (ὄφρά κεν ἔλθητον ’so that you two may come’) · also + subj. in a temporal clause after ὄφρ’ ἂν: ’as long as’ (ὄφρ’ ἂν … κεν ὁρᾷ ’as long as he sees’) · also ἐπεί κεν + fut. indic., in a temporal clause: ’as soon as’ (ἐπεί κεν … παραλέξομαι ’as soon as I shall lie beside’) · also ἠέ κεν + aor. inf., a potential alternative: ’or to perish’ (ἠέ κεν … ὀλέσθαι) · also ὁπποτέρῳ κεν + subj., in an indirect question: ’to which of the two … may’ · also ἐπεί κεν + aor. subj., in a temporal clause: ’once’ (ἐπεί κ’ ἀπὸ τεύχεα δύω ’once I put off my armour’) · also ὄφρά κεν + subj., temporal: ’until’ (ὄφρά κεν εὕρῃ ’until he finds’) · also εἴ κεν + subj., in an indirect question: ’whether’
